judgment.rationale: This is not a 0.101 regression report. The issue was filed for 0.99.1 and 0.101 appears only as the maintainer-requested retest/fix version.
evidence: Original report says a monitor blanks when brightness exceeds its real maximum and asks for manual min/max controls.
Issue labels include Needs-Author-Feedback and Product-PowerDisplay.
Maintainer asked the reporter to upgrade to 0.101 and try again because fixes exist in 0.100 and 0.101.
No reporter follow-up exists after that request.
judgment.recommended_action: Wait for author response; do not start design unless post-0.101 evidence remains.

issue_context.summary: Reporter asks for Power Display minimum/maximum brightness limits because their monitor turns off above a threshold on 0.99.1.
known_information: The issue body is in Portuguese and describes a monitor blanking above brightness 89.
PowerToys version is 0.99.1 and installation method is Microsoft Store.
Maintainer comment asks for an upgrade to 0.101 and retest due to fixes in 0.100 and 0.101.
There are no comments after the maintainer request.
inferences: The report may represent an older PowerDisplay range-handling issue or a feature request for per-monitor caps, but current evidence does not show 0.101 is affected.
A full design would require confirmation that the 0.101 PowerDisplay fixes did not resolve the issue.
issue_context.analysis: The current action is author-side confirmation already requested upstream; asking again would duplicate existing evidence collection.
initial_investigation: No linked fixing PR was found in the issue timeline.
Search for max cap mode shows related PowerDisplay monitor compatibility issues but no newer direct duplicate for this min/max cap request.
